titleEn: Bank of Ireland to showcase sustainability supports for farmers at Ploughing
titleZh: 爱尔兰银行将在全国耕作锦标赛展示面向农民的可持续发展支持
summaryZh: 爱尔兰银行将在2026年全国耕作锦标赛上展示面向农业客户的AI工具、可持续发展挂钩贷款及农业专业支持，并与谷歌合作提供最多1万份Google AI专业证书奖学金。文章还介绍了Enviroflex可持续发展贷款及农民在太阳能和粪污储存方面的投资趋势，体现了金融机构推动农业数字化与可持续发展的最新动向。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了银行与谷歌合作将AI工具引入农业金融服务的实践，对智慧畜牧行业人士了解金融机构如何推动农业数字化转型和可持续发展具有参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Ploughing 2026 Visitors Guide Bank of Ireland to showcase sustainability supports for farmers at Ploughing ![Image 1: Kathleen O'Sullivan By Kathleen O'Sullivan September 10, 2026 11:15 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorkathleen-o-sullivan) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsbank-of-ireland-to-showcase-sustainability-supports-for-farmers-at-ploughing) Bank of Ireland is set to showcase a range of supports for agricultural customers at this year's National Ploughing Championships. These include artificial intelligence (AI) tools, sustainability-focused loans, and agri-sector expertise designed to help farms be more productive, resilient and future-ready. In partnership with Google, up to 10,000 Google AI Professional Certificate scholarships are available to Bank of Ireland’s small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) customers including farmers. Throughout the National Ploughing Association (NPA) event, Google representatives will be on hand at the Bank of Ireland stand to demonstrate how AI tools can help farming businesses improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity. In addition, real-time financial farming data will be used to highlight how AI can be utilised to enhance on-farm efficiency. The bank will also be showcasing Enviroflex, its sustainability-linked loan for farmers. Investment A recent agricultural sector report by Bank of Ireland shows that investment in sustainability by farmers continues to grow, with funds used to install solar panels and increase slurry storage. This enables many to avail of the Targeted Agricultural Modernisation Scheme (TAMS 3) supports. Bank of Ireland head of agriculture, Eoin Lowry said:“Farming enterprises need accessible, user-friendly tools to build their AI capability and confidence. "The growth in farmers implementing sustainable practices and improvements is clear from our analysis of Enviroflex applications. "Investing selectively in sustainability and efficiency improvements ensures the farm is better protected and future proofed for the next generation of farmers." Bank of Ireland's agri and business banking teams will be available throughout the three-day event to meet existing and prospective customers at Stand 212, Row 11, Block 4. translationZh:
爱尔兰银行将在今年的全国耕作锦标赛上展示一系列面向农业客户的支持措施。这些措施包括人工智能（AI）工具、以可持续发展为重点的贷款，以及旨在帮助农场提高生产力、韧性和面向未来能力的农业领域专业知识。

爱尔兰银行与谷歌合作，向其中小企业（SME）客户（包括农民）提供最多10,000份Google AI专业证书奖学金。在全国耕作协会（NPA）活动期间，谷歌代表将在爱尔兰银行展台现场演示AI工具如何帮助农业企业提高效率、决策能力和生产力。此外，还将使用实时财务农业数据来展示如何利用AI提升农场效率。

该银行还将展示其面向农民的可持续发展挂钩贷款Enviroflex。

**投资**

爱尔兰银行最近的一份农业行业报告显示，农民在可持续发展方面的投资持续增长，资金被用于安装太阳能电池板和扩大粪污储存能力。这使许多人能够获得目标农业现代化计划（TAMS 3）的支持。

爱尔兰银行农业主管Eoin Lowry表示：“农业企业需要易于获取、用户友好的工具来建立其AI能力和信心。”

“从我们对Enviroflex申请的分析中可以清楚看到，农民实施可持续实践和改进措施的增长。”

“有选择地投资于可持续发展和效率提升，可以确保农场得到更好的保护，并为下一代农民做好未来准备。”

爱尔兰银行的农业和商业银行业务团队将在为期三天的活动中全程在场，在4号区块11排212号展台与现有和潜在客户会面。
